# Film signature: the matrix and the feed come back in front before the close

## Context

Take `2026-10-10T23-28-03-475Z` at dev a852b8ca6e (#15252, 2026-10-10 23:28Z) is the first take whose signature was frame-checked. Emmy's inspection (23:37Z): at recording 86 s the active tab of `scale-tabs` is **Security**, the 100k Matrix is inactive; `bottom-tabs` shows **Metrics**, the Live Event Stream is inactive. The signature's `scroll` cue reports success (`index: 50000`), but the hundred-thousand-row grid it scrolls is behind a tab, and the feed whose heartbeat the close narrates is behind another. The picture cannot carry M08 ("jump to the middle") or the living close.

Design authority: the screenplay's own claim ledger (`fiveBeatFilm.mjs`: "living-content continuity → the Feed store's monotonic sequence (scenes 1, 9)" and "the hundred-thousand-row matrix crosses its midpoint") — the close claims both panes visible; the operator's 2026-10-10 brief (a stunning film, the narration whole).

## The Problem

Two earlier scenes change the active tabs on purpose and nothing restores them: the showcase drops Metrics into `bottom-tabs` (`tab-into`, the drop activates the dropped tab → the feed is hidden from ≈ 70 s on), and the perspectives scene's `addTab` + redo make Security the active item of `scale-tabs` (the screenplay's own `expect` pins `activeItemId: 'security'`). The signature then scrolls a hidden grid. Every earlier take had the same picture; nobody had frame-checked the end.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/dashboard/dock/model/Operations.mjs` `setActiveItem(document, {tabsNodeId, itemId})` — a committed document operation; membership validated; an already-active item is a successful byte-identical no-op (so it runs in both tiers of the screenplay, document and live).
- `apps/workstation/tour/fiveBeatFilm.mjs` `film-signature`: `scroll` cue → `topology-assert` readout → the living close.
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/tour/fiveBeatFilm.spec.mjs` "the document tier runs twice… ends with Security in the matrix group" pins `scale-tabs.activeItemId === 'security'` at the end; the film witness asserts the restore/undo/redo memberships.

## The Fix

In `film-signature`, before the scroll: two `op` steps — `{operation: 'setActiveItem', tabsNodeId: 'scale-tabs', itemId: 'scale'}` and `{operation: 'setActiveItem', tabsNodeId: 'bottom-tabs', itemId: 'feed'}` — each with its `expect` on `activeItemId`; the readout pins both active items. The unit spec's end-state assertion moves from `activeItemId 'security'` to `'scale'` (Security stays a member of the matrix group). No engine change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `fiveBeatFilm.spec`: the document tier ends with `scale-tabs.activeItemId === 'scale'`, `bottom-tabs.activeItemId === 'feed'`, Security still in `scale-tabs.items`; the cue list is unchanged.
- [ ] `WorkstationFilmTourNL` 3/3 and `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL` 5/5; the receipt's final document shows both active items.
- [ ] Post-merge: the next take's frames at the scroll and at the close show the 100k Matrix and the Live Event Stream (#15252).

## Out of Scope

- A real drag-scroll of the matrix revealing its canvas columns — the sibling leaf filed with this one.
